raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: Misidentified Lord Patrick Crichton-Stuart’s father. The Wikipedia snippet stated his father was John Stuart, Lord Mount Stuart (eldest son of the 1st Marquess), but the Planner incorrectly concluded the father was John Stuart, 1st Marquess of Bute. This led to searching for and reporting the 1st Marquess’s death date (16 November 1814) instead of the actual father’s death date (22 January 1794).
